English: I understand why you reacted that way, but I think the situation would have been easier to resolve if we had discussed it calmly from the beginning.
Lingala: Nasosoli mpo na nini osalaki réaction ndenge wana, kasi nakanisi ete likambo yango elingaki kozala pete mingi mpo na kosilisa soki tosololaki na kimia banda na ebandeli.

English: I was about to leave when you called me, so if you had phoned five minutes later, you probably would not have reached me.
Lingala: Nazalaki pene ya kobima ntango obengaki ngai; soki obengaki ngai sima ya miniti mitano, mbala mosusu olingaki kozwa ngai lisusu te.

English: Even though I disagreed with what he said, I did not want to interrupt him before he had finished explaining his point of view.
Lingala: Ata soki nandimaki te makambo oyo alobaki, nalingaki te kokata ye maloba liboso asilisa kolimbola makanisi na ye.

English: I don't mind helping you, but I would appreciate it if you told me earlier next time instead of waiting until the last minute.
Lingala: Ezali problème te kosalisa yo, kasi mbala ya sima nalingaki o-yebisa ngai liboso na esika ya kozela tii na minute ya suka.

English: The problem is not that you made a mistake; the real problem is that you refused to admit it even after everyone explained what had happened.
Lingala: Problème ezali te ete osalaki libunga; problème ya solo ezali ete oboyaki kondima yango ata sima bato nyonso balimbolaki yo ndenge makambo esalemaki.

English: There are moments when saying nothing is wiser than responding emotionally to something you may later regret.
Lingala: Ezali na bantango oyo kofanda kimia ezali na bwanya mingi koleka koyanola na kanda na likambo oyo okoki koyokela mawa na sima.

English: I did not expect the conversation to become so serious, because at first we were simply joking with each other.
Lingala: Nakanisaki te ete conversation ekokóma sérieux ndenge wana, mpo na ebandeli tozalaki kaka kosakana na maloba.

English: You don't have to agree with me, but at least try to understand why I see the situation differently.
Lingala: Osengeli te kondima makanisi na ngai, kasi ata moke meká kososola mpo na nini nazali komona likambo yango ndenge mosusu.

English: What bothered me most was not what happened, but the fact that nobody thought it was necessary to tell me.
Lingala: Eloko oyo epesaki ngai pasi mingi ezalaki te likambo oyo esalemaki, kasi ndenge moto moko te akanisaki ete esengeli koyebisa ngai.

English: If I had known that you were going through such a difficult situation, I would have tried to support you much earlier.
Lingala: Soki nayebaki ete ozalaki koleka na situation ya mpasi ndenge wana, nalingaki komeka kosunga yo banda kala.

English: Before we move forward with the project, we need to make sure that everyone clearly understands their responsibilities and deadlines.
Lingala: Liboso tokende liboso na projet, tosengeli kosala ete moto nyonso asosola malamu ba responsabilités na ye mpe ba délais.

English: The proposal looks promising, but we still need more evidence before we can justify investing additional resources.
Lingala: Proposition yango ezali komonana malamu, kasi tosengeli naino na ba preuves mingi liboso tókoka koloba ete ezali na ntina kotia ba ressources mosusu.

English: One of the biggest challenges we are facing is that different departments are working independently instead of sharing information.
Lingala: Moko ya mikakatano minene oyo tozali kokutana na yango ezali ete ba départements ekeseni bazali kosala separément na esika ya kokabola ba informations.

English: I suggest that we postpone the final decision until we have reviewed all the financial and technical implications.
Lingala: Napesi likanisi ete tozongisa mokano ya suka sima tii tokotala malamu ba conséquences financières mpe techniques nyonso.

English: We need to distinguish between problems that require an immediate solution and those that can be addressed gradually.
Lingala: Tosengeli kokesenisa ba problèmes oyo esengeli kosilisa mbala moko na oyo tokoki kosilisa mokemoke.

English: The client was satisfied with the general direction of the project, but asked us to simplify the user experience.
Lingala: Client asepelaki na direction générale ya projet, kasi asɛngaki biso tósala expérience ya utilisateur ezala simple koleka.

English: I would rather deliver a smaller but reliable product than promise too many features that we cannot maintain properly.
Lingala: Nakosepela mingi kopesa produit ya moke kasi oyo ezali fiable, na esika ya kolaka ba fonctionnalités mingi oyo tokokoka te kobatela malamu.

English: If the team continues working at this pace, we should be able to complete the first version before the end of the month.
Lingala: Soki équipe ekobi kosala na rythme oyo, tosengeli kozala na makoki ya kosilisa version ya liboso liboso ya suka ya sanza.

English: The fact that the first attempt failed does not necessarily mean that the entire strategy is wrong.
Lingala: Ndenge tentative ya liboso elongaki te elingi koloba forcément te ete stratégie mobimba ezali mabe.

English: A good manager should know when to give instructions and when to allow people to solve problems independently.
Lingala: Mokambi ya malamu asengeli koyeba ntango nini kopesa malako mpe ntango nini kotika bato básilisa mikakatano bango moko.

English: The purpose of this study is not merely to reproduce previous results, but to determine whether the same conclusions remain valid under weaker assumptions.
Lingala: Mokano ya étude oyo ezali kaka te kozongela ba résultats ya liboso, kasi kotala soki ba conclusions yango etikali solo ata soki ba hypothèses ekómi makasi mingi te.

English: At first, the theorem appears obvious, but the proof becomes much more subtle when the space is infinite-dimensional.
Lingala: Na ebandeli, théorème yango emonani lokola ezali évident, kasi preuve ekómaka compliqué mingi soki espace ezali ya dimension infinie.

English: We should be careful not to confuse a sufficient condition with a necessary condition.
Lingala: Tosengeli kokeba ete tóbulunganisa te condition suffisante na condition nécessaire.

English: The numerical experiments support the theoretical result, although they do not constitute a proof by themselves.
Lingala: Ba expériences numériques ezali kosunga résultat théorique, atako yango moko ekoki kozala preuve te.

English: The main contribution of the paper lies in the way it extends a classical method to a setting where the usual assumptions no longer hold.
Lingala: Contribution ya monene ya article ezali ndenge yango etandisi méthode classique na cadre moko oyo ba hypothèses oyo basalelaka mbala mingi esalaka lisusu te.

English: Before accepting this conclusion, we should examine whether the argument depends on finite-dimensionality at any crucial step.
Lingala: Liboso tóndima conclusion oyo, tosengeli kotala soki raisonnement esaleli dimension finie na étape moko ya ntina.

English: The notation may look complicated, but the underlying idea is actually quite simple once the geometric interpretation is clear.
Lingala: Notation ekoki komonana compliqué, kasi idée oyo ezali na se na yango ezali simple soki compréhension géométrique ekómi polele.

English: This result is interesting because it establishes a connection between two areas that are usually studied separately.
Lingala: Résultat oyo ezali intéressant mpo ezali kosala lien kati na ba domaines mibale oyo bayekolaka mbala mingi separément.

English: We still need to determine whether the estimate is sharp or whether the constant can be improved.
Lingala: Tosengeli naino koyeba soki estimation yango ezali sharp to soki constante ekoki kobongisama lisusu.

English: A counterexample would be enough to show that the statement is false without the additional assumption.
Lingala: Contre-exemple moko ekoki kokoka mpo na kolakisa ete affirmation yango ezali lokuta soki hypothèse mosusu ebakisami te.

English: A business can generate a lot of revenue and still fail if its operating costs are too high.
Lingala: Entreprise ekoki kozwa mbongo mingi na chiffre d'affaires kasi ekoki kaka kokweya soki ba coûts ya fonctionnement ezali likoló mingi.

English: Before launching the product, we should identify exactly who our customers are and what problem they are willing to pay us to solve.
Lingala: Liboso ya kobimisa produit, tosengeli koyeba mpenza ba clients na biso bazali banani mpe problème nini bazali prêt kofuta biso mpo tósilisa yango.

English: Low prices may attract customers at first, but they are not a sustainable strategy if the company loses money on every transaction.
Lingala: Ba prix ya se ekoki kobenda ba clients na ebandeli, kasi stratégie yango ekoki koumela te soki entreprise ezali kobungisa mbongo na transaction nyonso.

English: I would not invest in the company simply because the idea sounds exciting; I would first examine the market, the team, and the business model.
Lingala: Nakotia mbongo na entreprise kaka te mpo idée ezali koyokana kitoko; nakotala liboso marché, équipe mpe business model.

English: The company needs to decide whether rapid growth is more important than becoming profitable in the short term.
Lingala: Entreprise esengeli kozwa mokano soki croissance ya mbangu ezali na ntina mingi koleka kozala rentable na ntango mokuse.

English: Having many users does not necessarily mean that a product has a strong business model.
Lingala: Kozala na ba utilisateurs mingi elingi koloba forcément te ete produit ezali na business model ya makasi.

English: We underestimated how expensive customer acquisition would become once the market became more competitive.
Lingala: To-estimaki na se ndenge acquisition ya ba clients ekokóma cher soki concurrence ekómi makasi.

English: If we depend entirely on one large customer, losing that customer could put the whole company at risk.
Lingala: Soki entreprise etie motema nyonso na client moko ya monene, kobungisa client yango ekoki kotia entreprise mobimba na danger.

English: Artificial intelligence can automate many repetitive tasks, but human judgment remains essential when decisions have serious consequences.
Lingala: Intelligence artificielle ekoki kosala automatiquement misala mingi oyo ezongaka mbala na mbala, kasi jugement ya moto etikali na ntina mingi soki ba décisions ezali na ba conséquences ya makasi.

English: A model can achieve very high accuracy during testing and still perform poorly when it encounters data that differs from the training distribution.
Lingala: Modèle ekoki kozwa accuracy ya likoló mingi na test, kasi kosala mabe soki ekutani na ba données oyo ekeseni na oyo basalelaki mpo na ko entraîner yango.

English: The fact that an algorithm gives an answer does not mean that the answer is reliable or appropriate for every context.
Lingala: Ndenge algorithme epesi eyano elingi koloba te ete eyano yango ezali fiable to ebongi na contexte nyonso.

English: We should not collect more personal data than we genuinely need simply because the technology allows us to do so.
Lingala: Tosengeli te kosangisa ba données personnelles mingi koleka oyo tosengeli na yango kaka mpo technologie ezali kopesa biso possibilité yango.

English: One of the biggest challenges in AI is not only building powerful models, but understanding when they should not be trusted.
Lingala: Moko ya mikakatano minene na AI ezali kaka te kotonga ba modèles ya makasi, kasi koyeba ntango nini esengeli te kotiela yango motema.

English: If the system cannot explain why it rejected a person's application, that can become a serious problem when the decision affects their rights.
Lingala: Soki système ekoki te kolimbola mpo na nini eboyi demande ya moto, yango ekoki kokóma problème monene soki décision yango ezali kosimba makoki na ye.

English: Technology should be designed around the needs of people, rather than forcing people to adapt unnecessarily to the technology.
Lingala: Technologie esengeli kotongama kolanda ba besoins ya bato, na esika ya kosenga bato bábongwana kaka mpo na technologie.

English: I don't expect you to understand everything I am feeling, but I would like you to listen without immediately judging me.
Lingala: Nazali kozela te ete ososola nyonso oyo nazali koyoka, kasi nalingi oyoka ngai liboso ya ko juger ngai mbala moko.

English: Sometimes people distance themselves not because they stopped caring, but because they no longer know how to communicate what they are feeling.
Lingala: Ntango mosusu bato bakendaka mosika te mpo balingi yo lisusu te, kasi mpo bayebi lisusu te ndenge ya koloba oyo bazali koyoka.

English: Trust takes a long time to build, but it can be destroyed very quickly when someone repeatedly breaks their promises.
Lingala: Confiance ezwaka ntango mingi mpo etongama, kasi ekoki kobeba noki soki moto azali mbala na mbala kokokisa te bilaka na ye.

English: Forgiving someone does not always mean that you have to allow them to return to your life in the same way as before.
Lingala: Kolimbisa moto elingi koloba ntango nyonso te ete osengeli kotika ye azonga na bomoi na yo ndenge ezalaki liboso.

English: I would rather hear an uncomfortable truth than a comforting lie that will create more problems later.
Lingala: Nakosepela mingi koyoka solo oyo ezali pasi koleka lokuta oyo ekopesa ngai kimia lelo kasi ekobimisa mikakatano mingi na sima.

English: We cannot solve a problem if every conversation turns into an argument about who is right and who is wrong.
Lingala: Tokoki te kosilisa problème soki conversation nyonso ekómaka kaka etumba ya koyeba nani azali na raison mpe nani azali na tort.

English: A society cannot develop sustainably if economic growth benefits only a small part of the population.
Lingala: Société ekoki te kokola na ndenge ya koumela soki croissance économique ezali kosalisa kaka eteni moke ya bato.

English: Education should not only prepare people to find jobs, but also teach them how to think critically and participate responsibly in society.
Lingala: Éducation esengeli kaka te kobongisa bato mpo bázwa mosala, kasi mpe koteya bango kokanisa na mayele mpe kozwa responsabilité na société.

English: People often underestimate how strongly their environment influences the decisions they believe they are making independently.
Lingala: Bato mingi bayebaka te ndenge environnement na bango ezali ko influencer ba décisions oyo bakanisaka ete bazali kozwa bango moko.

English: Progress does not always happen in a straight line; sometimes a temporary setback reveals weaknesses that need to be corrected.
Lingala: Progrès etambolaka ntango nyonso droit te; ntango mosusu recul ya mwa ntango elakisaka bolɛmbu oyo esengeli kobongisama.

English: Having access to information is not the same as having the ability to distinguish reliable information from misinformation.
Lingala: Kozala na accès na information ezali ndenge moko te na kozala na makoki ya kokesenisa information ya solo na information ya lokuta.

English: A difficult decision may still be the right decision even when it makes some people unhappy in the short term.
Lingala: Décision moko ekoki kozala mpasi kasi kozala kaka décision ya malamu, ata soki na ntango mokuse bato mosusu bakosepela na yango te.

English: It is easy to criticize a decision after seeing the consequences, but the people who made it did not have all the information we have today.
Lingala: Ezali pete ko critiquer décision sima ya komona ba conséquences, kasi bato oyo bazwaki yango bazalaki na ba informations nyonso oyo biso tozali na yango lelo te.

English: I am not saying that his argument is completely wrong; I am saying that it relies on an assumption that has not yet been justified.
Lingala: Nazali koloba te ete raisonnement na ye ezali mabe mobimba; nazali koloba ete etie motema na hypothèse moko oyo naino elakisami te ete ezali juste.

English: Just because something has always been done in a certain way does not mean that it is still the best way to do it.
Lingala: Kaka mpo likambo esalamaka ndenge moko banda kala elingi koloba te ete yango nde ezali naino lolenge ya malamu koleka lelo.

English: I would be more convinced by the argument if it were supported by evidence rather than by personal experience alone.
Lingala: Nakondima raisonnement yango mingi soki ezalaki kosimbama na ba preuves, na esika ya expérience personnelle kaka.

English: The question is not whether the technology can be built, but whether building it would actually solve the problem we are trying to address.
Lingala: Motuna ezali te soki tokoki kotonga technologie yango, kasi soki kotonga yango ekosilisa mpenza problème oyo tozali komeka kosilisa.

English: We should avoid making permanent decisions based on emotions that may disappear after a few hours or days.
Lingala: Tosengeli kokeba na kozwa ba décisions ya seko na ba émotions oyo ekoki kosila sima ya bangonga to mikolo moke.

English: Sometimes the most difficult part of solving a problem is realizing that we have been asking the wrong question from the beginning.
Lingala: Ntango mosusu eteni ya mpasi mingi na kosilisa problème ezali koyeba ete banda na ebandeli tozalaki kotuna motuna ya mabe.

English: I don't want to jump to conclusions before hearing his side of the story.
Lingala: Nalingi te kozwa mokano nokinoki liboso nayoka mpe ye ndenge amoni likambo yango.

English: At the end of the day, we have to deal with the consequences of our own decisions.
Lingala: Na suka ya nyonso, biso moko nde tosengeli komema ba conséquences ya ba décisions oyo tozwi.

English: What you are saying makes sense in theory, but I am not sure it will work in practice.
Lingala: Oyo ozali koloba ezali na sens na théorie, kasi nayebi te soki ekosala malamu na pratique.

English: I would rather admit that I don't know than pretend to understand something I haven't understood.
Lingala: Nakosepela mingi kondima ete nayebi te na esika ya kosala lokola nasosoli likambo oyo nasosoli mpenza te.

English: The more you understand a subject, the more you realize how much there is still left to learn.
Lingala: Soki ozali kokóma kososola sujet moko mingi, okomona mpe mingi ete ezali naino na makambo ebele ya koyekola.
